cohort: 50 patients with early-onset idiopathic chronic pancreatitis (EOICP) who had disease onset before their pregnancies contributed to a total of 86 pregnancies.
finding: Mothers affected with EOICP have pregnancy outcomes similar to healthy women in India, with no significant differences in spontaneous pregnancy losses, gestational diabetes, gestational hypertension, preterm labor, or birth weight.
mod_finding: Delivery by LSCS was significantly higher in the EOICP cohort (49.3%) compared to the average rates in India (21.5%).
